description: Structured eval definitions for the Kinesis Stream Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across stream configurations (on-demand with enhanced fan-out and SSE-KMS, provisioned with shard sizing, multi-consumer enhanced fan-out, cross-account resource policy, missing stream mode decision). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: On-demand Kinesis stream with enhanced fan-out consumer and SSE-KMS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — on-demand mode, enhanced fan-out consumer, SSE-KMS with CMK, CloudWatch IteratorAge alarm
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Kinesis Data Stream named telemetry-ingest in us-east-1. Use on-demand capacity mode. Register an enhanced fan-out consumer named realtime-processor. Enable SSE-KMS with customer-managed key alias/kinesis/telemetry-ingest. Set retention to 168 hours. Producer is EC2 role EC2-producer-role. Consumer is Lambda role Lambda-consumer-role. CloudWatch alarm for IteratorAge > 300000ms to SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:alerts. Tags: Environment=production, Service=telemetry. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KINESIS_STREAM: telemetry-ingest (arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/telemetry-ingest)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Stream name: telemetry-ingest
  [✓] Stream mode: ON_DEMAND
  [✓] Shard count: N/A (on-demand auto-scales)
  [✓] Retention period: 168 hours
  [✓] Enhanced fan-out: realtime-processor
  [✓] SSE-KMS: enabled (alias/kinesis/telemetry-ingest)
  [✓] KMS key policy: permits kinesis.amazonaws.com
  [✓] Producer IAM: EC2-producer-role
  [✓] Consumer IAM: Lambda-consumer-role → SubscribeToShard
  [✓] CloudWatch alarm: IteratorAgeMilliseconds > 300000
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kinesis describe-stream-summary --stream-name telemetry-ingest --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Provisioned Kinesis stream with shard count sized to throughput
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — provisioned mode, shard count from write throughput (5 MiB/sec + 3000 records/sec → 5 shards), standard GetRecords consumer
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Kinesis Data Stream named events-stream in us-east-1. Use provisioned capacity mode. Expected write throughput is 5 MiB/sec and 3000 records/sec. Use standard GetRecords consumer (no enhanced fan-out). Retention 48 hours. Producer is ECS task role events-producer-role. Consumer is EC2 role events-consumer-role. CloudWatch alarms for IteratorAge and WriteProvisionedThroughputExceeded to SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:alerts. Tags: Environment=staging, Service=events. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KINESIS_STREAM: events-stream (arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/events-stream)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Stream name: events-stream
  [✓] Stream mode: PROVISIONED
  [✓] Shard count: 5 (sized for 5 MiB/sec + 3000 records/sec)
  [✓] Retention period: 48 hours
  [✓] Enhanced fan-out: Standard GetRecords
  [✓] Producer IAM: events-producer-role → PutRecord, PutRecords
  [✓] Consumer IAM: events-consumer-role → GetRecords, GetShardIterator
  [✓] CloudWatch alarm: IteratorAgeMilliseconds > 300000
  [✓] CloudWatch alarm: WriteProvisionedThroughputExceeded > 0

eval_cases.name: Provisioned stream with multiple enhanced fan-out consumers
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — provisioned 10-shard stream, 4 enhanced fan-out consumers with SubscribeToShard, SSE-KMS AWS-managed key
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Kinesis Data Stream named clickstream in us-east-1. Provisioned mode, 10 shards. I have 4 consumer applications that each need dedicated read throughput with low latency. Register enhanced fan-out consumers: realtime-analytics, ml-feature-pipeline, audit-logger, data-archive. Retention 72 hours. SSE-KMS with AWS-managed key alias/aws/kinesis. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KINESIS_STREAM: clickstream (arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/clickstream)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Stream name: clickstream
  [✓] Stream mode: PROVISIONED
  [✓] Shard count: 10
  [✓] Retention period: 72 hours
  [✓] Enhanced fan-out: realtime-analytics, ml-feature-pipeline, audit-logger, data-archive
  [✓] SSE-KMS: enabled (alias/aws/kinesis)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kinesis list-stream-consumers --stream-arn arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/clickstream --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Kinesis stream with cross-account read access via resource policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — on-demand stream with cross-account read access via stream ARN resource policy for account 999999999999
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Kinesis Data Stream named shared-events in us-east-1. On-demand mode. Account 123456789012 owns the stream. A consumer application in account 999999999999 needs to read records (GetRecords and GetShardIterator). Retention 24 hours. No enhanced fan-out. Use a stream resource policy for cross-account access. Producer is in account 123456789012 role stream-producer-role. Tags: Environment=production, SharedWith=analytics-org.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KINESIS_STREAM: shared-events (arn:aws:kinesis:us-east-1:123456789012:stream/shared-events)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Stream name: shared-events
  [✓] Stream mode: ON_DEMAND
  [✓] Retention period: 24 hours
  [✓] Resource policy: cross-account read for 999999999999
  [✓] Producer IAM: stream-producer-role

eval_cases.name: Operator requests stream without specifying stream mode or capacity
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — stream mode (provisioned vs on-demand) is a prerequisite decision not provided
eval_cases.prompt: I need a Kinesis stream for my new application. Name it app-events. Region us-east-1. I'm not sure about the throughput yet — just create it and I'll figure out capacity later. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KINESIS_STREAM: app-events
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Stream mode: NOT specified — provisioned vs on-demand capacity model is a prerequisite decision
  [✗] Shard count: NOT specified (required if provisioned mode; irrelevant if on-demand)
  [✗] Producer IAM principal: NOT specified
  [✗] Consumer IAM principal: NOT specified
